voodoo.definition:
n. (Haiti) followers of a religion that involves witchcraft and animistic deities
n. a religious cult practiced chiefly in Caribbean countries (especially Haiti); involves witchcraft and animistic deities
v. bewitch by or as if by a voodoo
voodoo.translation: n. 伏都教, 巫术, 巫术信仰

voodooed.definition: v bewitch by or as if by a voodoo
voodooed.translation: v. 施巫术以迷惑( voodoo的过去分词 )

voodooing.definition: v bewitch by or as if by a voodoo
voodooing.translation: v. 施巫术以迷惑( voodoo的现在分词 )

voodooism.definition: n a religious cult practiced chiefly in Caribbean countries (especially Haiti); involves witchcraft and animistic deities

voodooist.translation: n. 伏都教信徒, 魔术师

voodoos.definition:
n a charm superstitiously believed to embody magical powers
n (Haiti) followers of a religion that involves witchcraft and animistic deities
n a religious cult practiced chiefly in Caribbean countries (especially Haiti); involves witchcraft and animistic deities

voodoos.translation:
n. （尤指西印度群岛等地的）伏都教, 巫术( voodoo的名词复数 )
